summary: Decomposes the position difference between a target vehicle and a reference point (a5, a7) into longitudinal and lateral components relative to the direction vector (a2, a4). Loads the target position through the this[0] indirection pointer (obj+0x34E0, obj+0x34E8), subtracts the reference, writes the signed longitudinal distance into this[3] and the signed lateral distance into this[1]. Called every frame from AISteering (004270a0).

local_names.this: spatial/relative-vector accumulator; this[1] lateral distance, this[3] longitudinal distance

operations.description: Load target position through the this[0] indirection (px from obj+0x34E0, py from obj+0x34E8) and subtract the reference point: v7 = px - a5, v8 = py - a7
v9 = a4*v8 + a2*v7, the dot product of the offset vector against the direction
Longitudinal distance: build v21=a2*v9, v24=a4*v9, store the signed sqrt of (v24*v24 + v21*v21) into this[3] (sign from compare flags)
Lateral distance: v15 = a2*v8 - a4*v7 (cross term), then v22=-a4, v23=v22*v15, v25=a2*v15, store the sign-inverted sqrt of (v25*v25 + v23*v23) into this[1]
